# WhatsApp Messaging Now Available for Telnyx AI Assistants

### 23, Nov 2026

AI Assistants can now handle WhatsApp messaging conversations alongside voice calls. The same assistant logic, prompts, and knowledge sources that power your voice agents now work on WhatsApp, so customers can reach you on their preferred channel without rebuilding anything.

### What's new

- WhatsApp messaging channel for AI Assistants: Configure any existing AI Assistant to accept and respond to WhatsApp messages. Same LLM, same system prompt, same tools. No new assistant to build.

- One number, every channel: A single Telnyx number now handles PSTN voice, SMS, WhatsApp messaging, and WhatsApp calling. One number, one analytics view, one billing relationship.

- Template and free-form messaging: Send pre-approved template messages for notifications and marketing. Reply with free-form messages inside the 24-hour customer conversation window for real-time support.

- Webhook-based message handling: Inbound WhatsApp messages trigger your assistant through the existing webhook infrastructure. The assistant processes the message, calls tools if needed, and responds on WhatsApp.

### Why it matters

- WhatsApp has 3.3 billion users across 180+ countries. Customers already use it every day. Meeting them there means higher engagement, faster responses, and fewer missed connections compared to email or phone-only support.

- Building a WhatsApp bot today means a separate provider, a separate LLM integration, and a separate knowledge base. With this release, your Telnyx AI Assistant handles both voice and WhatsApp messaging. One platform, one SLA, one source of truth for what the agent knows and how it responds.

- WhatsApp messages have 90%+ open rates compared to roughly 20% for email. For appointment reminders, order updates, and verification codes, WhatsApp means customers actually see and act on the message.

- A customer can start a conversation on WhatsApp and escalate to a voice call on the same number. The assistant maintains context across channels because it is the same assistant.

### Example use cases

- Customer support: Customers message on WhatsApp with a question. The AI Assistant responds instantly, looks up account info via tools, and resolves the issue in chat. If the conversation needs voice, the customer calls the same number and the same assistant picks up with full context.

- Appointment reminders and confirmations: Send a WhatsApp template message with appointment details. The customer replies with a free-form message to confirm, reschedule, or cancel. The assistant handles the response and updates the calendar.

- Order and shipping updates: Notify customers when their order ships, when delivery is attempted, or when a payment is processed. Two-way messaging lets customers ask follow-up questions without switching channels.

- Multi-language support: The same assistant that handles voice calls in 80+ languages now handles WhatsApp messages in the same languages. No additional configuration needed.

### Getting started

- Connect your WhatsApp Business Account in Mission Control under Messaging then WhatsApp and complete the embedded signup flow.

- Verify a Telnyx number for WhatsApp. The number must have an active messaging profile.

- Configure your AI Assistant to handle WhatsApp messages by adding the WhatsApp messaging channel in your assistant settings. See the AI assistant conversations guide .

- Set up a webhook endpoint to receive inbound WhatsApp messages and route them to your assistant.

- Send a test message from your phone to your Telnyx WhatsApp number and verify the assistant responds.

curl -X POST "https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/assistants/{assistant_id}/chat/whatsapp" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "from": "+13125550001", "to": "+13125550002", "content": "Send the login verification code 482913 to the customer.", "conversation_metadata": {"order_id": "A1"} }'

Explore the WhatsApp Business API product page and see WhatsApp pricing .

Start building using the AI assistant conversations guide and WhatsApp messaging docs .
